text: Every Codex run the factory makes turns off, along with its apps, plugins and web search, the Codex features that browse, act on the desktop, generate images, suggest tools, install skills' dependencies or spawn more agents: browser_use, browser_use_external, in_app_browser, computer_use, image_generation, tool_suggest, skill_mcp_dependency_install and multi_agent. Codex 0.163.0 turns each on by default, and an agent gets exactly the file tools and Invariant's own (D-0037). Codex refuses a feature it doesn't know, so the check before Codex runs makes sure this Codex knows each one (#221).
